name: Applied Optoelectronics

eyebrow.en: Applied Optoelectronics, Inc. · Common stock · Sugar Land, Texas
eyebrow.zh: Applied Optoelectronics · 普通股 · 德州糖城

title.zh: 全力扩建 800G 与 1.6T 产能。

lede.en: AOI makes optical transceivers and lasers, now mostly for AI data centers. Revenue rose 128% to a record $270M last quarter and it turned a small GAAP profit; Q4 is guided to $385–420M. It is still pouring cash into new capacity, paid for by selling shares, and its US plants are delayed by power hookups.
lede.zh: AOI 生产光模块与激光器，现主要供应 AI 数据中心。上季营收增 128% 至创纪录的 2.7 亿美元，并实现小幅 GAAP 盈利；第四季指引 3.85–4.2 亿。公司仍靠增发新股大举投资扩产，美国工厂则因电力接入而延误。

sub_price.en: Daily closes with the 50-day average. The stock went from about $19 to $234 within the year and now sits near $47; beta is about 3.8.
sub_price.zh: 每日收盘价与50日均线。一年内股价由约 $19 涨至 $234，现约 $47；贝塔值约 3.8。

sub_rev.en: Revenue in US$ millions, with GAAP gross margin on the right axis. Q4 2024 GAAP EPS of −$2.60 reflects a one-time non-cash charge. The last bar is guidance at the midpoint.
sub_rev.zh: 营收单位为百万美元，右轴为 GAAP 毛利率。2024 年第四季 GAAP 每股 −$2.60 反映一次性非现金费用。最后一根柱为指引中值。

s.zh: 同比 +128% · 连续第6季创纪录
中值低于约 4.27 亿的市场预期

p.en: AOI signed a multi-year strategic agreement with a Tier 1 hyperscale customer, which management says improves long-term visibility. Data center sales rose 254% to $156M in Q3.
p.zh: AOI 与一家一级大型云厂商签订多年战略协议，管理层称这提升了长期能见度。第三季数据中心收入增 254% 至 1.56 亿美元。

p.en: Capacity is near 330,000 units a month. The end-2026 target is now over 500,000 800G/1.6T units, down from over 650,000; over 1M is targeted by end-2027 as US plants wait for power.
p.zh: 目前月产能接近 33 万件。2026 年底 800G/1.6T 月产能目标由逾 65 万下调至逾 50 万件；美国工厂等待电力接入，2027 年底目标逾 100 万件。

p.en: The Q4 revenue midpoint of $402.5M trails the ~$427M consensus. Non-GAAP gross margin is guided to 29.5–31%, up from 28.7% in Q3.
p.zh: 第四季营收指引中值 4.025 亿美元，低于约 4.27 亿的市场预期。非 GAAP 毛利率指引 29.5–31%，高于第三季的 28.7%。

p.en: Paid-in capital rose $1.53B in nine months as AOI sold shares to fund factories; the Q4 EPS guide assumes about 96M shares, up from 75M at end-2025.
p.zh: AOI 增发新股为建厂融资，前九个月实收资本增加 15.3 亿美元；第四季每股指引按约 9600 万股计算，2025 年底为 7500 万股。

p.en: Equipment for over 500,000 800G/1.6T units a month installed by year-end.
p.zh: 年底前安装足以月产逾 50 万件 800G/1.6T 的设备。

p.en: Guide: revenue $385–420M, non-GAAP gross margin 29.5–31%, EPS $0.48–0.63.
Texas plants delayed by power hookups; target over 1M 800G/1.6T units a month.
p.zh: 德州工厂因电力接入延误；目标月产逾 100 万件 800G/1.6T。

sources: Q3 results and Q4 guide vs consensus (Investing.com)
AI optical selloff on Nov 5 (Yahoo Finance)
Price, consensus and 52-week range: Stocklake daily closes and MarketBeat, as of Nov 5, 2026

foot.en: Fundamentals as of Nov 5, 2026 (Q3 2026 results). For information only, not investment advice. Not affiliated with Applied Optoelectronics, Inc..
foot.zh: 基本面数据截至 2026年11月5日（2026 年第三季业绩）。仅供参考，不构成投资建议。与 Applied Optoelectronics, Inc. 无关联。

sub.en: Free cash flow is operating cash flow minus capital spending, in US$ millions, for the 20 quarters from Q3 2021 to Q2 2026; Q3 2026 cash flow comes with the 10-Q and is shown as an estimate. Shaded bars and italic rows are estimates.
sub.zh: 自由现金流 = 经营现金流 − 资本开支，单位百万美元，涵盖 2021 年第三季至 2026 年第二季共 20 个季度；2026 年第三季现金流待 10-Q 公布，暂列为估算。浅色柱与斜体行为估算。

s.zh: 2026年9月30日 · 含 1600 万受限现金

read.en: AOI has burned cash in 18 of the last 20 reported quarters, and Q2 2026 was the extreme: $575M of capex for free cash flow of −$564M. The Q3 cash flow statement comes with the 10-Q, but net property and equipment rose $347M in the quarter to $1.04B, so the build-out kept a similar pace.
read.zh: 过去 20 个已公布季度中 AOI 有 18 个季度烧钱，2026 年第二季最为极端：资本开支 5.75 亿美元，自由现金流 −5.64 亿。第三季现金流量表将随 10-Q 公布，但当季固定资产净额增加 3.47 亿美元至 10.4 亿，扩建步伐相近。

read.en: Cash rose to $621M from $509M in June only because AOI kept selling shares: paid-in capital is up $1.53B this year. I assume capex near $300M in Q4, easing to about $200M a quarter in 2027 as the US plants slip, and operating cash flow turning positive as revenue nears $400M a quarter. That is about −$670M over the next four quarters, more than the cash on hand.
read.zh: 现金由 6 月的 5.09 亿美元增至 6.21 亿，完全依靠持续增发：今年实收资本增加 15.3 亿美元。我假设第四季资本开支约 3 亿美元，2027 年随美国工厂延后降至每季约 2 亿，经营现金流随季度营收接近 4 亿而转正。未来四季合计约 −6.7 亿美元，超过账上现金。

p.en: Power hookups have delayed the 2027 US expansion; net property and equipment reached $1.04B at Sep 30, up from $376M in December.
p.zh: 电力接入延误 2027 年美国扩产；9 月 30 日固定资产净额达 10.4 亿美元，去年 12 月为 3.76 亿。

p.en: Enough equipment for over 500,000 800G/1.6T units a month by end-2026 and over 1M by end-2027.
p.zh: 2026 年底设备足以月产逾 50 万件 800G/1.6T，2027 年底逾 100 万件。

p.en: Paid-in capital rose $1.53B in the first nine months of 2026; a $600M sale plan was filed in August.
p.zh: 2026 年前九个月实收资本增加 15.3 亿美元；8 月再提交 6 亿美元增发计划。

p.en: Q4 revenue guided to $385–420M, backed by a new multi-year Tier 1 hyperscaler agreement.
p.zh: 第四季营收指引 3.85–4.2 亿美元，并有新签的一级云厂商多年协议支撑。

bridgeNote.en: A negative result means AOI would need more equity or debt; it has been selling shares every quarter.
bridgeNote.zh: 结果为负意味着 AOI 需要更多股权或债务融资；公司每季都在增发。
